description: The permission gate and the tools of external MCP servers (plan task ext-12): lib/permissions.mjs (the name rule, the category external, the owner's policy and trust, the decisions by mode and execution policy, no path inspection, the mcp card, the audit row) and lib/hooks.mjs (the alias of an external tool follows the same name rule), judged by tests/verify-mcp-gate.mjs.

mutations.name: MG-external-as-workspace-edit
mutations.what: an external tool is treated as a workspace edit (it runs unasked in Autonomous, like before ext-12)

patches.old: return {category:'external',reason:`Công cụ MCP bên ngoài (máy chủ ${server})`
patches.new: return {category:'workspace_edit',reason:`Công cụ MCP bên ngoài (máy chủ ${server})`

mutations.name: MG-classified-by-name
mutations.what: an external tool is classified by its name again (the regexes of classify)

mutations.name: MG-full-access-ignores-deny
mutations.what: Full Access runs a tool the owner denied

mutations.name: MG-deny-ignored
mutations.what: an explicit deny refuses nothing

mutations.name: MG-hook-question-beats-deny
mutations.what: a hook's question turns a deny into a question

mutations.name: MG-readonly-hint-untrusted
mutations.what: readOnlyHint is trusted without trustAnnotations

mutations.name: MG-default-allow
mutations.what: the default policy (nothing set) is allow

mutations.name: MG-default-allow-unattached
mutations.what: a gate with no external policy attached allows every external tool

mutations.name: MG-default-allow-attached
mutations.what: an attached policy that leaves policyFor out allows every external tool

mutations.name: MG-unreadable-policy-asks
mutations.what: a policy answer that is none of ask/allow/deny is taken as ask (it should refuse)

mutations.name: MG-unreadable-policy-allows
mutations.what: a policy answer that is none of ask/allow/deny ('ALLOW', true, 1) is taken as allow

mutations.name: MG-throwing-policy-allows
mutations.what: a policy that throws allows the call

mutations.name: MG-policy-not-awaited
mutations.what: an async policy is not awaited

mutations.name: MG-policy-without-tool
mutations.what: the policy is asked about the server only, not the tool

mutations.name: MG-trust-truthy
mutations.what: any truthy answer of trustAnnotations ('true', 1) is trust

mutations.name: MG-throwing-trust-trusts
mutations.what: a trust function that throws trusts the server

mutations.name: MG-trust-not-per-server
mutations.what: the trust is asked about another server than the call's

mutations.name: MG-attach-drops-trust
mutations.what: attachExternalPolicy ignores trustAnnotations

mutations.name: MG-attach-default-trusts
mutations.what: an attached policy that leaves trustAnnotations out trusts every server

mutations.name: MG-hints-any-type
mutations.what: a hint that is not a boolean is kept

mutations.name: MG-readonly-allow-enough
mutations.what: Read Only runs a tool that is allowed, without a trusted readOnlyHint

mutations.name: MG-readonly-hint-enough
mutations.what: Read Only runs a tool with a trusted readOnlyHint that the owner did not allow

mutations.name: MG-readonly-refuses-all
mutations.what: Read Only refuses even an allowed tool with a trusted readOnlyHint

mutations.name: MG-sandbox-lets-external
mutations.what: sandbox-only lets an external tool through

mutations.name: MG-full-access-asks
mutations.what: Full Access asks about every external tool (the owner decided it runs them)

mutations.name: MG-allow-asks
mutations.what: an allowed tool is still asked about

mutations.name: MG-hook-question-ignored
mutations.what: a hook's question is not asked where the call would run

mutations.name: MG-irreversible-name-ignored
mutations.what: a name that says delete, push or publish runs unasked in Full Access and under allow

mutations.name: MG-always-ask-ignored
mutations.what: the always-ask names (github_pr_merge, github_release_create) run unasked for an external server

mutations.name: MG-irreversible-case
mutations.what: a destructive name in capitals is not seen

mutations.name: MG-irreversible-reads-server
mutations.what: the name of the server decides too (every tool of a server called pushover asks under Full Access)

mutations.name: MG-serverless-name-asked
mutations.what: a name without a server is asked about (and runs in Full Access) instead of refused

mutations.name: MG-paths-inspected
mutations.what: the workspace path inspection is applied to an external tool (an outside path throws again)

mutations.name: MG-external-question-runs
mutations.what: an external call that should be asked runs instead

mutations.name: MG-no-full-access-event
mutations.what: an external call run by Full Access is not announced

mutations.name: MG-refusal-row-without-server
mutations.what: the history row of a refused external call does not name the server and the tool

mutations.name: MG-request-without-server
mutations.what: the approval request (and its history row) does not name the server and the tool

mutations.name: MG-pending-without-server
mutations.what: the pending list does not name the server and the tool

mutations.name: MG-card-not-mcp
mutations.what: an external call gets the old card (no detail)

mutations.name: MG-card-kind
mutations.what: the card of an external call is not of kind mcp

mutations.name: MG-card-raw-arguments
mutations.what: the arguments of an external call are the raw JSON, not masked

mutations.name: MG-card-launch-unmasked
mutations.what: the command that starts the server is shown unmasked

mutations.name: MG-card-full-url
mutations.what: the whole address of an HTTP server is shown (user, password, path, query)

mutations.name: MG-card-origin-null-string
mutations.what: an address without an origin (file:) shows the word null

mutations.name: MG-card-describe-dropped
mutations.what: attachExternalPolicy ignores describeServer

mutations.name: MG-card-command-list-dropped
mutations.what: a command given as a list is not shown

mutations.name: MG-card-transport-uncut
mutations.what: the transport is not cut

mutations.name: MG-card-launch-uncut
mutations.what: the command that starts the server is not cut

mutations.name: MG-name-case-insensitive
mutations.what: Local.x and STUDIO.x are taken for the Hub's own tools (HubManager routes them to the external backend)

mutations.name: MG-name-last-dot
mutations.what: the server is read up to the last dot instead of the first

mutations.name: MG-hooks-alias-without-server
mutations.what: the hooks give a name without a server an mcp__ alias
